posts.headline: KurdistanWatch sets out a structured read on Iranian Kurdish opposition groups, weapons and funding flows
posts.summary: KurdistanWatch posts a numbered thread on the Iranian Kurdish opposition groups and their weapons posture, tracing the funding sources the groups have drawn on and how that has shaped their operational footprint inside the Kurdistan Region through the war cycle.

posts.headline: Halwest Movement's Islam Zebari, a former Peshmerga officer, detained for five days in Sulaimani
posts.summary: KurdistanWatch reports that Islam Zebari, a former Peshmerga officer and senior figure in the opposition Halwest Movement, has been detained for five days in Sulaimani, extending the run of opposition-figure detentions through the KRG cabinet deadlock and the parallel Lahur Sheikh Jangi security investigation.

posts.headline: Pro-Lahur media outlets circulate detainee-guard allegations as Sheikh Jangi defence pushes Erbil transfer
posts.summary: KurdistanWatch flags that media outlets close to jailed politician Lahur Sheikh Jangi are circulating allegations involving one of his detained guards, Hamarash, layered on top of the defence team's formal effort to move the case from Sulaimani to the Kurdistan Region Court of Cassation in Erbil.

posts.headline: KIU leader Bahaddin meets PUK's Bafel Talabani in Sulaimani on cabinet-deadlock mediation
posts.summary: KurdistanWatch reports that Kurdistan Islamic Union leader Salahaddin Bahaddin met PUK president Bafel Talabani in Sulaimani on Sunday inside the KIU's broader mediation push to break the eighteen-month KRG cabinet-formation deadlock, layered on top of sources saying both KDP and PUK have offered KIU multiple high-level cabinet posts.

posts.headline: AMrym mocks the operational profile of an unnamed adversary navigating modern surveillance and satellite coverage
posts.summary: AMrym posts a quote-tweet asking how they sleep and how they move under modern satellite surveillance and sensor coverage, framed as commentary on the operational difficulty of evading detection inside the current Hormuz-area surveillance picture. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: AMrym flags global oil prices continuing to rise to roughly $110 per barrel
posts.summary: AMrym reports that global oil prices are continuing to climb, reaching about $110 per barrel as the Hormuz war cycle deepens, the Barakah drone strike rattles the GCC tape and the Trump deadline pressure on Iran keeps the upside bid in place. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: FlightRadar shows Iranian and Iraqi airspace empty of civil aviation as escalation cycle tightens
posts.summary: AMrym cites FlightRadar showing that Iranian and Iraqi airspace are now empty of any civilian aviation traffic, an immediate operational indicator of carriers re-routing around both countries as the US-Iran escalation cycle reopens ahead of the Tuesday Situation Room session in Washington. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: AMrym says Trump is publicly mapping a US encirclement posture around Iran
posts.summary: AMrym argues Trump is publicly laying out a US encirclement framing around Iran with the regional basing footprint and the open Project Freedom file, treating it as a deliberate signalling exercise inside the broader pressure cycle ahead of the Tuesday national-security meeting. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: AMrym reports aerial-refueling flights originating from Tel Aviv tracked over Samawah desert
posts.summary: AMrym posts that aerial-refueling aircraft originating from Tel Aviv have been tracked operating in the skies above Iraq's Samawah desert, framing it as another indicator of the cross-Iraq military activity baked into the current escalation cycle. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: AMrym relays Saudi claim of three drones from Iraq intercepted over the Kingdom
posts.summary: AMrym relays the Saudi defence ministry claim that three drones whose source was Iraqi territory were intercepted after entering the Kingdom's airspace, the same incident that drove the GCC condemnation chorus through Sunday night and the Kuwaiti foreign ministry's overnight statement. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: AMrym surfaces a fresh public message from Iranian foreign ministry spokesman Esmail Baghaei
posts.summary: AMrym amplifies a public statement by Iranian foreign ministry spokesman Esmail Baghaei, framed as Tehran's diplomatic response to the latest US escalation rhetoric and the Trump deadline messaging on the one-page MOU. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: AMrym claims two US Navy fighter aircraft crashed after a mid-air collision
posts.summary: AMrym posts that two US Navy fighter aircraft crashed after colliding with each other, a claim that lands inside the broader pattern of US Navy carrier-air losses through the Hormuz deployment cycle and that has not yet been formally confirmed by US Central Command. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Iraqi MP Hiyam al-Yasiri opens public fire on the former health minister
posts.summary: AMrym reports MP Hiyam al-Yasiri publicly attacking the former Iraqi health minister, inside the broader pattern of post-cabinet-vote score-settling that has been running across Baghdad's political class since the partial al-Zaidi cabinet was sworn in. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: AMrym cites US media saying Washington could strike Iran as early as tomorrow
posts.summary: AMrym amplifies a US-media report saying the United States could attack Iran early tomorrow, an indication of the compressed pre-strike timing rhetoric ahead of the Tuesday Situation Room session that Axios has separately reported. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Israeli public broadcasting cites official saying United States and Israel are coordinating on the Iran file
posts.summary: AMrym relays an Israeli public broadcasting report quoting an official describing the United States and Israel as actively coordinating on Iran, sustaining the dual-track signalling that has been a feature of the pre-Tuesday escalation cycle. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: AMrym quote-tweets Trump saying the next strike on Iran would be very large and stronger
posts.summary: AMrym amplifies Trump's call that the next strike on Iran would be very large and stronger than what has come before, a public-pressure escalation that lands alongside the Trump warning that there will not be anything left of Iran if the one-page MOU is not accepted. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: AMrym surfaces Washington sources on an imminent US move against Iran
posts.summary: AMrym posts what he frames as very important Washington sourcing on an imminent US move against Iran, sustaining the AMrym feed's view that the Tuesday session at the White House is being treated as more than a routine review. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: AMrym quotes Trump telling Iran the clock is ticking and to move quickly
posts.summary: AMrym relays Trump's public message that for Iran the time is running out and that they must move quickly, in line with the rhetoric Trump rolled out across the weekend ahead of Tuesday's Situation Room session on the Iran options menu. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: IEA says oil exports bypassing the Strait of Hormuz have risen by 1.5 million bpd to almost 8 million bpd
posts.summary: Bachar El-Halabi retweets the International Energy Agency reporting that oil exports bypassing the Strait of Hormuz have risen by roughly 1.5 million barrels per day to almost 8 million barrels per day, the clearest single read on how Gulf producers have rerouted around the chokepoint through the war-cycle force-majeure period.

posts.headline: IAEA confirms radiation levels at UAE's Barakah nuclear plant remain normal after the drone strike
posts.summary: Bachar El-Halabi retweets the IAEA confirming it has been informed by the UAE that radiation levels at the Barakah Nuclear Power Plant remain normal following Sunday's drone strike on an external electrical generator, the formal technical clearance that anchored the international response to the incident.

posts.headline: Authorities in Abu Dhabi respond to a generator fire at the UAE's Barakah nuclear plant
posts.summary: Bachar El-Halabi posts the official UAE line that authorities in Abu Dhabi responded to a fire incident that broke out in an electrical generator outside the inner perimeter of the Barakah Nuclear Power Plant, in line with the Emirates Nuclear Energy Corporation's framing that plant safety and operations were not affected.

posts.headline: 55-year nominal and real oil price chart resurfaces as the Hormuz crisis reframes the long-cycle base
posts.summary: Bachar El-Halabi retweets a 55-year chart of nominal and real oil prices, surfacing it as a long-cycle reference point against which the current $108 to $111 Brent print, the Iraqi force-majeure period and the GCC infrastructure-attack cycle have to be read.
